expo.name: ORBB
expo._comment: Synthetic M0 shell. No API keys, no credentials, no real medical data. CI typechecks only — no native build is produced at M0. M4-C: the orbb-health-plugin registers the HealthKit Info.plist usage descriptions (TEXT ONLY) and the Health Connect manifest permissions (TEXT ONLY) for the @orbb/platform device-source seams; native bindings arrive with the deployment/mobile-integration milestone.
